channel.title: World Boxing News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from World Boxing News (worldboxingnews.com)

item.title: Isis Sio Knocked Out 50 Days Before Camarillo Fight as Timeline Emerges
item.description: Isis Sio was knocked out just 50 days before facing Jocelyn Camarillo. Her recent fight timeline is now coming into focus following hospitalization.

item.title: Jocelyn Camarillo Makes Plea as Isis Sio Remains Critical
item.description: Jocelyn Camarillo makes an emotional plea as opponent Isis Sio, 19, remains in critical condition following their fight.

item.title: Giyasov Calls for ‘Justice’ Amid WBA Uncertainty Over Haney vs Rolly
item.description: Shakhram Giyasov calls for “justice” as the WBA title situation remains unresolved following reports of Haney vs Rolly for May 30.

item.title: Bomac Brands Mbilli ‘Email Champion,’ Calls For Martinez Rematch
item.description: Brian Bomac McIntyre blasts Christian Mbilli as an “email champion” and demands a Lester Martinez rematch as WBC controversy deepens.

item.title: IBF Upholds Jai Opetaia Title Loss Over Zuffa Belt Dispute
item.description: IBF upholds Jai Opetaia’s title loss after the Zuffa belt dispute, confirming the cruiserweight championship is now vacant.

item.title: Isis Sio Family Clarifies 50-Day KO Timeline as Boxer Shows Recovery Signs
item.description: The family of Isis Sio clarifies the 50-day knockout timeline and provides a positive update on the boxer’s recovery while she remains in ICU.

item.title: Alexander Povetkin Record Remains Intact Despite Order to Disqualify Results
item.description: Alexander Povetkin’s professional record remains intact despite an anti-doping ruling that ordered results dating back to 2014 to be disqualified.

item.title: IBF Ruling Creates Champion Recruitment Problem for Zuffa Boxing
item.description: The IBF ruling that stripped Jai Opetaia of his cruiserweight title highlights a challenge for Zuffa Boxing as champions weigh the risks of losing belts.

item.title: IBF Title Loss Puts Jai Opetaia’s Zuffa Future in Doubt
item.description: Jai Opetaia faces uncertainty over his Zuffa future after the IBF vacated his cruiserweight title following the Brandon Glanton fight.

item.title: Boxing’s Next Step? A Super Bowl Halftime Fight
item.description: Could boxing stage a fight during Super Bowl halftime? World Boxing News examines whether the sport’s next step could reach the biggest stage.
